heroSummary: The Bambu Lab A1 handles eSUN eTPU-95A reliably out of the box using its stock stainless steel direct-drive toolhead and open frame. Safe maximum throughput is limited to 54 mm/s based on an effective 4.5 mm³/s volumetric flow limit to prevent filament buckling in the extruder.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate + Glue Stick (strictly as a release agent)
slicerTweaks: Cap 'Max volumetric speed' at exactly 4.5 mm³/s in the Filament settings to automatically clamp linear speeds to safe thresholds.
Enable 'Avoid crossing walls' with a max detour length factor to route travel moves through the infill and reduce visible stringing.
Set Retraction distance to 0.8 mm and Retraction speed to 30 mm/s with 2.0 mm wipe distance to minimize nozzle oozing.
Set outer wall speed to 35-40 mm/s and inner wall speed to 50 mm/s to ensure consistent extrusion width on perimeter walls.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Filament buckling or jamming inside extruder gears
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Backpressure caused by exceeding 4.5 mm³/s volumetric flow or printing at too low a nozzle temperature.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Ensure Max Volumetric Speed is set to 4.5 mm³/s, increase nozzle temperature to 220°C, and keep speeds under 54 mm/s.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Severe stringing, surface fuzz, and popping noises
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Hygroscopic moisture absorption converting to steam in the meltzone during travel moves.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dehydrate the filament spool in a dedicated dryer at 65°C for 6 to 8 hours and print directly from a sealed drybox.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Permanent bonding and bed surface tearing upon print removal
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: High chemical affinity between molten TPU and bare PEI coating without a separation barrier.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply a thin, uniform layer of PVP glue stick as a sacrificial release agent and let the bed cool below 30°C before removing.

faq.question: Can I feed eSUN eTPU-95A through the Bambu Lab AMS Lite?
faq.answer: No, flexible filaments like eTPU-95A will buckle and jam within the AMS Lite drive gears and long PTFE tubing; feed it directly from the external spool holder.

faq.question: Do I need a hardened steel nozzle to print eSUN eTPU-95A on the Bambu Lab A1?
faq.answer: No, eSUN eTPU-95A contains no abrasive fibers or particles, so the stock A1 stainless steel nozzle works optimally without premature wear.

faq.question: Why does OrcaSlicer print slower than my configured 100 mm/s speed setting?
faq.answer: OrcaSlicer enforces the 4.5 mm³/s volumetric speed limit, which automatically clamps linear print speed to roughly 54 mm/s at standard 0.2mm layer heights.

faq.question: Does the Bambu Lab A1 need an enclosure to print TPU successfully?
faq.answer: No, TPU does not require an enclosure and prints best in open-air environments to prevent heat creep in the extruder cold block.
